issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (console a11y warning). Non-blocking but should add DialogDescription for screen-reader users.

critical_code_review_comments: Delete confirm UX relies on a transient hint (delete-confirm-{id}) that likely times out — consider explicit confirmation modal for destructive ops, or at least a visible countdown/second-click affordance.

Archive endpoint currently supports one-way move; there is no un-archive/restore endpoint or UI to browse /archive/. Consider adding GET /api/tracker/archive and POST /sessions/{id}/restore for completeness.

turn_history is appended on every record_usage but not bounded — for long-lived sessions this array grows unbounded in JSON state. Add a cap (e.g., last 500 turns) or downsampling for very long sessions.
Org Usage Panel: no client-side validation on org-days-input (accepts arbitrary integers/negatives). Backend enum validation covers provider but days is not bounded.
seed_data_creation: Two throwaway sessions were created via ai_context_tracker.ContextTracker.record_usage() and then archived/deleted through the API as part of the test. Archive folder cleaned up at end. Latest.json restored to seeded 3aacc4b13b92. Final state: only the 3 seeded sessions (3aacc4b13b92, 0b15287ef875, b98b6f902048) remain; /root/.ai-context-tracker/archive/ is empty.
